conventions.speedup: speedup_baseline_over_weaver = baseline wall time / weaver wall time; greater than 1 means weaver finished sooner
conventions.cpu: cpu baseline_over_weaver = baseline CPU seconds / weaver CPU seconds; weaver_cpu_percent_less = (1 - weaver/baseline) * 100
conventions.wall_metric: submission_to_terminal_verified_output: from NZB submission until the client reports a terminal state and the harness has verified the output bytes
conventions.aggregation: per stratum: geometric mean over paired blocks with a bootstrap 95% CI; per phase and headline: geometric mean over strata
conventions.blocks: each stratum pairs every client on the same fixture, link, and transport; a block is one measured repetition of every client; strata with fewer complete blocks than minimum_complete_blocks are withheld
conventions.did_not_finish: a run the client never brought to a terminal state inside the job timeout
conventions.rigs: rigs are named by CPU architecture, operating system, and how the clients ran (container or native); no machine identities are recorded

rows.label: Usenet standard
rows.definition: 1 Gbit/s link at 10 ms and 100 ms RTT, TLS and plaintext, every fixture in the corpus (phases B3 and P3, both RTTs, geometric mean over all compared strata)

rows.label: Unthrottled
rows.definition: 10 Gbit/s link, 0 ms RTT, TLS, ten copies of the 200 MB direct download queued at once; time from first submission until the last copy is verified

rows.label: Edge cases
rows.definition: The subset of the Usenet standard strata whose fixture is a compressed RAR or 7z, a quick-open RAR, or needs PAR2 or recovery-volume repair
